messages:
Amy Chen: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need concrete owners and dates for the eval/test work from yesterday's incident. I sketched a draft plan below. Can folks pick owners?

Ravi Patel: Thanks Amy. Quick read: propose owners: infra stress tests -> Jules, prompt/regression sets -> me, CI job + canary -> Mariana. Ok?

Jules K: I can take the infra stress tests. I'll add a `kv-cache-stress` scenario to the load harness and run baseline by EOW. Steps: 1) add scenario 2) run at 2x production rps 3) add perf assertions. ETA Fri 2026-03-26.

Mariana (oncall): I can own CI job and canary. I'll add a nightly job `ci/evals/incident-2026-03-kv` and a staged canary check that fails if 95p latency regresses >15%. Will have PR up by Tue 2026-03-24 EOD.

Ravi Patel: For prompt/regression sets I'll curate the ~20 prompts from the incident and add to `evals/prompt_sets/kv_cache_regression.json`. I'll pair them with automated pass/fail rules (top-1 match + hallucination heuristics) and add to gating. ETA Mon 2026-03-29.

Amy Chen: Awesome. Two additional asks: (1) Add a short chaos drill to eng-sre calendar to exercise fallback routing; suggest Thu 2026-04-01. (2) Add postmortem action tracker row with owners + deadlines.

eng-sre-lead: I'm ok with Thu 2026-04-01 for a 1hr chaos drill. I'll invite product, infra, and support. We'll run a scripted capacity failover and validate canary fallback.

infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary-check job created for `ci/evals/incident-2026-03-kv` on Wed 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC.

Jules K: Quick note — the load test needs a synthetic dataset that matches median token lengths; I'll add a generator script and attach to PR. Example snippet:```python
# gen synthetic with median tokens
def gen(seq_count, median_len=120):
    for _ in range(seq_count):
        yield "x " * median_len
```

Mariana (oncall): Also adding alerting tweak: if KV cache miss rate spikes >5% for 5m, page oncall + create auto-rollto-slim-model runbook. Will get runbook drafted by Wed 2026-03-25.

Amy Chen: Great. For tracking, I'll update the postmortem with an action table. Current items assigned: infra stress (Jules) — Fri 2026-03-26; prompt set (Ravi) — Mon 2026-03-29; CI/canary (Mariana) — Tue 2026-03-24; chaos drill (eng-sre-lead) — Thu 2026-04-01; alert/runbook (Mariana) — Wed 2026-03-25. If this looks right, I'll lock dates and ping execs.

Ravi Patel: Looks good. Can we also add a regression gate to pre-merge tests so PRs touching cache logic must pass these evals? I'll add proposal in PR.

Jules K: Agree. Also recommend a monthly chaos rotation to avoid knowledge atrophy.

Mariana (oncall): +1 monthly rotation. I'll coordinate with ops.

Amy Chen: Thanks team. I'll update postmortem and create a follow-up thread in #postmortems with the final action table. :thumbsup:
